title: 50 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Making Plans)
description:
Learn 50 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 50 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Making Plans · Kupanga Mipango
1:25  Public Transportation · Usafiri wa Umma
2:34  Daily Routine · Ratiba ya Kila Siku
4:03  Phone Calls & Messages · Simu na Ujumbe
5:16  Inspiration · Msukumo
6:36  Wisdom · Hekima
8:01  Doctor & Pharmacy · Daktari na Dawa
9:19  Family & Home · Familia na Nyumbani

PHRASE LIST

MAKING PLANS · Kupanga Mipango
• What’s the plan for today? - Mpango wetu ni upi leo?  [mpango wetu ni Upi leo?]
• I’ll share options, you choose. - Nitakutumia chaguo, uamue.  [Nita-ku-tumIa CHa-guo, u-aMUE.]
• Let’s decide by tonight. - Tuamue hadi jioni.  [tu-aMUE haDi JO-ni.]
• Can we agree on a start? - Tuafikiane na wakati wa kuanza?  [tu-a-fi-KIa-ne na WAK-ti wa ku-ANza?]
• I need a little buffer time. - Nahitaji muda wa ziada kidogo.  [na-HI-ta-j i MU-da wa zi-A-da ki-Dogo.]
• Do we have a backup plan? - Tuna mpango wa dharura pia?  [tu-na mpANgo wa dha-ra-U-ra pi-a?]
• Let’s map the route first. - Tuanzie kupanga njia.  [tu-aNzie ku-panGA na-yi-a.]

PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION · Usafiri wa Umma
• Is this the right platform? - Hii jukwaa ni sahihi?  [HiIu juKwaa ni saHiiHi?]
• Does the bus stop near there? - Basi linasimama karibu huko?  [BaSi linaSimama kaRIBu HuKo?]
• Is there room for a stroller? - Kuna nafasi kwa kitembea mtoto?  [KuNa naFASi kwa kiTeMBea muTTo?]
• Please wait, I’m just getting on. - Tafadhali ngoja, naingia tu.  [TaFaDhali ngoja, naENga tu.]
• Next, which street are we on? - Baada ya hapo, tupo mtaani gani?  [BAada ya Hapo, tuPo mTAanii gaNi?]
• Will there be traffic today? - Kutakuwa na msongamano leo?  [KuTaKwa na mSOngoamano leO?]

DAILY ROUTINE · Ratiba ya Kila Siku
• I lace my shoes and head out - Nafunga kamba za viatu vyangu, kisha natoka nje  [Nafunga KAMBA za VIA TU vyangu, kisha natoka NJE]
• I review my schedule before meetings - Ninakagua ratiba yangu kabla ya mikutano  [Ninakagua RATIba yangu KA BLA ya mI KU ta no]
• I grab a quick snack at work - Naokota vitafunwa kwa haraka kazini  [NaOKOta VI taFUNWA kwa haRAka kaZINI]
• I take a short walk during lunch - Natembea muda mfupi wakati wa mapumziko ya chakula cha mchana  [Na TEMBEa MUda mfupi wa KA ti ya ma PUM ZI KO ya CHAK ula cha MCHANA]
• I step into the elevator, then breathe - Naingia kwenye lifti, halafu napumua tu  [Na IN gia kwenye LIFTI, ha lafu naPUMUA TU]
• I check my email once, then focus - Ninakagua barua pepe mara moja, kisha naanza kazi kwa makini  [Ninakagua baRUA pePE ma ra MOJA, kisha naANza KAzi kwa ma KINI]

PHONE CALLS & MESSAGES · Simu na Ujumbe
• Hi, I need help with my SIM - Habari, naomba msaada kuhusu SIM yangu  [HABARI, naOMba MSAADA kuHUSU SIM yangu]
• Sorry, wrong number, my bad - Samahani, nimekosea namba, pole  [saMAHANI, niMEKOsea NAMBA, POLE]
• Could you send the invoice by text? - Unaweza kutuma risiti kwa SMS?  [U-NAWeza kuTUMA RI-siti kwa SMS]
• I just arrived, where are you? - Nimefika tu, uko wapi?  [niMEfika TU, uKO wapi]
• Are you free to chat later? - Una muda baadaye tuongee?  [U-NA muDA baADAYE tuONgee]
• Please call when you step out - Nipigie simu ukitoka tu  [niPIGie SIMU uKITOKa TU]

INSPIRATION · Msukumo
• Message yourself, you’re worth trying. - Jisemee, wewe ni wa kujaribu.  [JISEMEE, wewe ni wa KUJARIBU.]
• Today, aim for steady, not perfect. - Leo lenga utulivu, si ukamilifu.  [LEO LENGA utulivu, si ukaMILIFU.]
• When you fall, stand up gently. - Ukidondoka, simama tena kwa upole.  [UKIDONdeKA, simama tena kwa UPOLE.]
• Call a friend, ask for help. - Piga simu kwa rafiki, omba msaada.  [PIGA SIMU kwa rafiki, OMba MSAADA.]
• Make it small, then make it move. - Iwe ndogo, halafu ianze kusonga.  [Iwe NDOGO, HALAFU ianze kuSONGA.]
• Your pace is still progress. - Mwanzo wako unaendelea, hata kama ni polepole.  [MWANZO wako unaENDelea, hata kama ni POLEpole.]

WISDOM · Hekima
• Choose your battles, not your mood. - Chagua vita unavyopambana navyo, si hisia zako.  [CHA-gua vi-ta u-na-yo-pam-bA-na na-vo, si hi-SI-a za-ko.]
• A quiet answer can end a fight. - Jibu la utulivu linaweza kumaliza ugomvi.  [JI-bu la u-tu-LI-vi li-na-we-za ku-MA-li-za u-goM-vi.]
• Trust actions more than perfect words. - Amini matendo kuliko maneno matamu.  [A-MI-ni ma-TEN-do ku-li-ko ma-NEN-o ma-ta-mu.]
• Pause before you act, not after. - Simama kabla ya kutenda, si baada.  [SI-ma-ma ka-bla ya ku-TEN-da, si BA-a-da.]
